title: PPMI Co-occurrence Matrix
learning_objectives: Count word–context co-occurrences in a window
Use PPMI rows as word vectors
hints: For each i, loop `j in range(max(0, i - window), min(len(s), i + window + 1))`, skipping j == i.
`P = C / N`, `pw = P.sum(1, keepdims=True)`, `pc = P.sum(0, keepdims=True)`.
Compute log2 only where C > 0: `np.log2(P / (pw * pc), where=C > 0, out=np.zeros_like(P))`, then clip at 0.

failure_feedback.advice: Count neighbours within the window inside each sentence, excluding the word itself.
OOV tokens still occupy positions; don't delete them before windowing.
PMI = log2(P(w,c) / (P(w)P(c))) with marginals from row/column sums.
Only take logs where C > 0 and clip negatives to 0.
